-- 插入示例向量数据（如果表为空）
INSERT INTO document_vectors (content, category, embedding) 
SELECT content, category, embedding::vector
FROM (
  VALUES 
    ('人工智能正在改变我们生活的各个方面', '技术', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('机器学习是AI的一个子集，专注于算法学习', '技术', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('深度学习使用神经网络模拟人脑工作', '技术', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('自然语言处理让计算机理解人类语言', '技术', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('计算机视觉使机器能够看见和理解图像', '技术', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('健康饮食和定期锻炼是长寿的关键', '健康', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('心理健康与身体健康同等重要', '健康', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('充足的睡眠对认知功能至关重要', '健康', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('中国经济持续增长，成为全球第二大经济体', '经济', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536))),
    ('数字化转型正在重塑传统商业模式', '商业', (SELECT ('[' || string_agg((random()::text), ',') || ']')::vector FROM generate_series(1, 1536)))
) AS t(content, category, embedding)
WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM document_vectors LIMIT 1);

-- 向量相似度搜索（使用余弦相似度）
WITH query_vector AS (
  SELECT '{{$json.query_embedding}}'::vector as vec
)
SELECT 
  id,
  content,
  category,
  created_at,
  1 - (embedding <=> (SELECT vec FROM query_vector)) as similarity_score
FROM document_vectors
WHERE 1 - (embedding <=> (SELECT vec FROM query_vector)) > 0.5
ORDER BY similarity_score DESC
LIMIT 3;
